decisions.reason: It is adjacent to the firm's existing voice and managed communications capabilities, so the firm can learn and improve it, but conferencing is less differentiated against broader collaboration tools.
This product sits squarely on the firm's owned metro fibre and data centre strengths and already shows market adoption, making it highly compatible with its knowledge base and strategy.
Optical spectrum connectivity directly builds on the firm's network engineering expertise and high-bandwidth infrastructure, fitting its move toward advanced software-defined connectivity.
A voice number ordering portal leverages the firm's software platforms, operational know-how and push toward real-time provisioning, so it is a natural capability extension.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer with weaker fit to the firm's forward-looking cloud and integrated infrastructure strategy, so learning and investment are likely to shift elsewhere.
Direct voice network connection still matches the firm's carrier and enterprise voice expertise, but it is less aligned than data-centric services with where the firm is investing for future growth.
